description: Authoritative Granblue Fantasy status effects catalog, covering boss buffs (dispel priority), party debuffs (cleanse priority), dispel/cleanse asset taxonomy, and autonomous survival decision rules.

bossBuffs.name: 100% Damage Cut / Absolute Barrier
bossBuffs.japaneseName: 全属性ダメージカット 100%
bossBuffs.description: Reduces all incoming elemental damage to 0. Must be dispelled immediately before any burst attack or damage skill dispatch.

bossBuffs.name: Repel (Damage Reflection)
bossBuffs.description: Reflects a percentage of incoming damage directly back to attacking party members. Attacking into high-potency Repel causes instant team suicide.

bossBuffs.name: Mirror Image (Other Self)
bossBuffs.description: Evades incoming single-target attacks. Absorbs full skill damage nukes. Dispel or multi-hit AoE required to strip.

bossBuffs.name: Elemental Absorption / Healing Guard
bossBuffs.description: Converts all incoming elemental damage into boss HP recovery. Attacking during absorption heals the boss back to full HP.

bossBuffs.name: Tri-Slash / Quad-Slash (Multi-Strike)
bossBuffs.description: Boss attacks 3 or 4 times per turn with catastrophic normal attack potency. Capable of shredding frontline in a single turn.

bossBuffs.name: Uplift (Charge Diamond Acceleration)
bossBuffs.description: Increases boss charge diamonds by 1 or more extra diamonds at the end of each turn, dramatically accelerating special attack / omen triggers.

bossBuffs.name: 50% DEF Up / Fortification
bossBuffs.description: Dramatically lowers player damage output, preventing omen damage thresholds and extending fight duration.

bossBuffs.name: Supplemental Damage (Boss)
bossBuffs.description: Adds flat bonus damage per hit to all multi-hit boss normal attacks and special moves.

bossBuffs.name: Transcendent / Golden Border Buff
bossBuffs.description: Permanent boss mechanic buff marked with a golden border. Immune to all Dispel effects. Automation must NOT waste dispel skills.

partyDebuffs.name: Zombified (Undead)
partyDebuffs.japaneseName: アンデッド / ゾンビ
partyDebuffs.description: CRITICAL LETHAL: Converts all incoming healing into true Plain Damage. Drinking a Green Potion or activating a Heal skill causes instant party wipe.

partyDebuffs.name: Paralysis / Stun
partyDebuffs.description: Renders affected party members completely unable to take actions, attack, use skills, or guard.

partyDebuffs.name: Petrified (Charge Bar Freeze)
partyDebuffs.description: Freezes charge bar accumulation at 0%, preventing charge attacks and fatal chain formation.

partyDebuffs.name: Skill Seal / Silenced
partyDebuffs.description: Completely prevents casting any ability across all cooldowns. Must be cleansed immediately via summon or auto-cleanse.

partyDebuffs.name: C.A. Seal / Charge Attack Blocked
partyDebuffs.description: Prevents unleashing Charge Attacks even when charge bar is 100%. Blocks C.A. omen cancelation.

partyDebuffs.name: Strong Poison / Putrefy / Death Rot
partyDebuffs.japaneseName: 強毒 / 腐食 / 灼熱
partyDebuffs.description: Deals massive percentage-based end-of-turn plain damage (15% to 25% max HP per turn), quickly bleeding the party to lethal thresholds.

partyDebuffs.name: Charm / Confuse
partyDebuffs.description: High chance for party members to skip their turn or attack fellow party members.

partyDebuffs.name: DEF Down / Armor Shattered
partyDebuffs.description: Lowers party defense by 20% to 50%, amplifying incoming boss damage significantly.

summons.name: Metatron (4★)

dispelEvaluationRules.rule: Scan enemy buff list for removable buffs (removable == true). If none exist, abort dispel dispatch.
If enemy buff contains Repel, 100% Damage Cut, or Elemental Absorption (dispelPriority == 'immediate'), pause all attack actions immediately.
Dispatch Beelzebub call if available (strips up to 3 buffs in a single action without skill lockout).
If remaining removable buffs > 0, dispatch MC / character dispel abilities in descending order of dispel count until enemy buffs == 0.

cleanseEvaluationRules.rule: Scan party debuff statuses at the start of turn prior to any skill/potion execution.
If ZOMBIFIED is detected on ANY active frontline party member, immediately activate Zombified Safety Interlock.
If Skill Seal or Paralysis is detected on MC, attempt Summon Cleanse (Ba'al or Lucifer 250) or backline/passive auto-cleanse.
If Cleanse skill is available (Panacea / Clear Mind), dispatch immediately before any healing action.

zombifiedSafetyInterlock.rule: UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE shall green_potion, all_potion, or heal_skill be dispatched while Zombified status is active on a party member. Cleanse must confirm resolved before heals unlock.
